frontier.setting.minimap.tooltip: Show the minimap on the HUD.
frontier.setting.corner.tooltip: Which corner of the screen the minimap sits in.
frontier.setting.size.tooltip: How wide the map is, in GUI pixels.
frontier.setting.zoom.tooltip: 1 is closest, 5 furthest. The zoom keys change it too.
frontier.setting.rotate.tooltip: On: the map turns so you always face up. Off: north is always up.
frontier.setting.minimap_frame.tooltip: Plain rim, frayed paper, or no frame at all.
frontier.setting.compass.tooltip: N, E, S and W round the edge of the minimap.
frontier.setting.coordinates.tooltip: Your X, Y and Z under the minimap.
frontier.setting.biome.tooltip: The biome you are in, under the minimap.
frontier.setting.day_night.tooltip: The minimap dims at night, as the world does.
frontier.setting.slopes.tooltip: Shade slopes so hills and valleys stand out.
frontier.setting.cave_mode.tooltip: Underground, under a roof or a glass dome (and in the Nether), the minimap fades over to the floor around you instead of the surface. The world map opens on your own cave layer.
frontier.setting.minimap_waypoints.toolt: Show waypoints on the minimap; far ones sit on its edge.
frontier.setting.beacons.tooltip: A coloured beam at each shown waypoint, seen through walls.
frontier.setting.labels.tooltip: Each shown waypoint's name and distance, floating in the world.
frontier.setting.label_range.tooltip: Hide beacons and labels further away than this many blocks (0 shows all).
frontier.setting.death_waypoint.tooltip: Mark where you last died. It clears itself when you get back there.
frontier.map.hint: Drag to move • Scroll to zoom • C for caves • [ ] layers • Right-click for a waypoint
frontier.list.title: Waypoints
frontier.list.empty: No waypoints here yet. Press New, or B in game.
frontier.edit.name: Name
frontier.confirm.question: Delete waypoint "%s"?
frontier.setting.mobs.tooltip: Creatures and players near you on the minimap. Hold the player list key (Tab) to see their names.
frontier.setting.mobs_passive.tooltip: Animals and other peaceful creatures, as green dots.
frontier.setting.mobs_range.tooltip: How far away dots show, in blocks. 0 matches what the minimap shows.
frontier.setting.mobs_height_fade.toolti: Dots far above or below you fade, with a tick on top (above) or underneath (below).
frontier.setting.mobs_world_map.tooltip: The world map shows what the minimap shows too: creatures, players, dropped items, things and marked blocks, with the same switches.
frontier.setting.mobs_villagers.tooltip: Villagers and wandering traders, in yellow.
frontier.setting.dot_style.tooltip: Dots, or each creature's face made from its own model and the texture the game draws it with, shown while names show (holding Tab, unless Names says otherwise). Anything without a face keeps its dot and shows its name instead.
frontier.setting.dot_names.tooltip: When faces and names show: while the player list key (Tab) is held, always, or never. Creatures with a face show the face; those without one, their name. On the world map, the dot under the pointer is named too.
frontier.setting.player_names.tooltip: While names show, players keep their name beside their head. Off: like every creature with a face, only the head.
frontier.setting.items.tooltip: Items lying on the ground, as small black dots on a light rim. While names show (Tab), each shows its icon and its name.
frontier.setting.objects.tooltip: Item frames, armour stands, minecarts, boats, paintings and cushions, as small purple diamonds. Off at first.
frontier.setting.storage.tooltip: Chests, barrels, shulker boxes, furnaces, hoppers and the like, as amber squares. Off at first.
frontier.setting.decor.tooltip: Signs, banners, beds, heads, lecterns, campfires and the like, as teal squares.
frontier.setting.sharp_maps.tooltip: Twice the pixels on both maps, every block a whole number of pixels with no blur. Off: the lighter first look.
frontier.setting.hide_with_f3.tooltip: The minimap steps aside while the F3 debug screen is up.
frontier.setting.map_compass.tooltip: A small compass in the world map's bottom right corner.
frontier.setting.map_menu.tooltip: Right-click on the world map for a menu: edit or remove a waypoint, add one, copy or share the spot. Off: right-click adds a waypoint.
frontier.map.hint_menu: Drag to move • Scroll to zoom • C for caves • [ ] layers • Right-click for options
frontier.setting.accent.tooltip: The colour of Frontier's cards and highlights. Sunrise orange (#F9801D) by default.
